title: Trade Reset
description: Cycle and reset villager trades from the trading UI.
body:
# Trade Reset

A lightweight utility mod that adds a **Reset** button (cycle icon `↻`) to the merchant trading window, allowing players to reset and roll new villager trades directly without having to break and replace workstations.

## Features

- **Icon Button:** A clean cycle button placed directly in the villager trade UI.
- **Safety Dialog:** If you have already traded with a villager and locked their trades (XP > 0), clicking reset clears all experience and prompts a confirmation screen first to prevent accidental resets.
- **Instant Roll:** If the villager has 0 XP, clicking the button instantly cycles/refreshes their trades with no prompts.
- **Multiplayer Support:** The mod is required on both the client (for the UI interface) and the server (to handle the reset logic and synchronization).

## Details

- **Platform:** Fabric
- **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.4 (26.2)
- **Dependency:** Fabric API
